status: FIRST-PASS bounded experimental panel. Every default, coefficient and mapping below is a CURRENT HYPOTHESIZED SIMULATOR DEFAULT, not an empirically calibrated truth, and not the full eventual MiT parameterization.
precedence: 2. gestalt-generated value: default + weight * transform(construct), clamped to 0..1 (only for constituents with a generated_by rule)
3. explicit constituent override (config 'constituent_overrides'); it REPLACES the generated value, it is never added to it
4. legacy low-level mechanism overrides (compatibility/debug); these replace the mechanism value the constituent produced and are logged

profile_modes.note: A profile MODE decides how the lower-level mechanisms that are NOT owned by one of the seven constituents are set. It does not change the seven constituents or their gestalt generation.

broad_legacy.label: Broad legacy profile
broad_legacy.residual_policy: legacy construct->mechanism rules drive the residual mechanisms (current behavior; default for bare launches)

compact_panel.label: Compact seven-variable panel
compact_panel.residual_policy: residual mechanisms are frozen at the compact-panel reference value; only the seven constituents vary
compact_panel.residual_reference_label: compact-panel reference (a fixed neutral simulator value, NOT a claim about normal human performance)

dik_push_propensity.label: DIK push propensity
dik_push_propensity.runtime: Pilot desirability of COMMUNICATE when the agent holds unshared role DIK (unsolicited provision); no effect without a provision opportunity

dik_request_propensity.label: DIK request propensity
dik_request_propensity.runtime: Pilot desirability of REQUEST_ASSISTANCE when a DIK gap is recognized; no effect without a recognized gap; routing by teammate model/role knowledge

externalization_propensity.label: Externalization propensity
externalization_propensity.runtime: Pilot desirability of EXTERNALIZE_PLAN when there is a knowledge/workspace gap to externalize; also the existing externalization hooks

memory_reliability.label: Memory reliability (retention only)
memory_reliability.runtime: Seeded periodic forgetting of acquired data/information elements; 1.0 = no ordinary decay. Independent of rule_accuracy and of both gestalts.

coordination_propensity.label: Coordination propensity
coordination_propensity.runtime: Pilot desirability of proposing/consulting team plans when a coordination opportunity exists; goal_alignment also scales existing team-goal adoption

backup_propensity.label: Backup propensity
backup_propensity.runtime: Pilot desirability of legal taskwork on another role's structure or shared infrastructure when the need is observable

task_execution_efficiency.label: Task execution efficiency
task_execution_efficiency.runtime: Existing action-duration hooks (transport/construction/repair/validation); supplies no knowledge and changes no goal preference

memory.note: p_forget per element per update = min(1, (1 - memory_reliability) * base_hazard_per_s * update_interval_s) once the element is older than grace_s since its last reinforcement. Hypothesized simulator default; retention only (no false memory, corruption, interference or confidence).
